A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same BRIDGE study, including complete appendices A–N. Text extraction and visual inspection support comparison of the methods, equations, tables, figures, and appendix material.

before.justification: v1 reports original generation and forecasting experiments, human evaluations of controllability, and ablations in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including generation benchmarks, human evaluations, component ablations, and forecasting with synthetic training data.

M1.justification: Equation (1) changes the stated denoising objective from an L1 penalty to a squared norm. The multi-agent workflow, prototype conditioning, architecture, and appendix algorithms remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish whether the objective revision reflects an implementation change or a correction.

E1.justification: Both versions use AirPassenger and Sunspots for text refinement, the same 12 in-domain generation datasets, Stock and Web for unseen-domain evaluation, and ILI/M4 for downstream forecasting. Newly discussed Time-MMD is not evaluated.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain TimeVQVAE, TimeGAN, GT-GAN, and TimeVAE. The downstream comparisons retain KernelSynth and the same four forecasting models. Existing ablated variants and agent strategies also remain; added related-work citations do not introduce evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: Appendix A.9 revises the reported ICL/STL setup: v1 describes periodicity-based text following decomposition, whereas v3 specifies component images alongside text describing the original, undecomposed series. This is a limited revision to the stated input protocol, without evidence of reruns. Main evaluation settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The text-type, agent-strategy, prototype-count, and encoder ablations retain their evidence, as do the STL examples and prototype visualizations. New Section 5.5 and Table 6 separate an existing strategy analysis from v1 Section 5.4/Table 5.

E5.justification: Both retain the same ± reporting in Table 1 and Appendix M's t-tests, 1,000 bootstrap resamples for OWA, and significance threshold. The significance table is only renumbered from Table 17 to Table 18; no new seed or repeated-run information appears.

E6.justification: The reported numerical results and qualitative examples match. v1 Table 5 is split into v3 Tables 5–6 without changing scores, and appendix results remain unchanged after renumbering. No updated results accompany the revised loss statement.

T1.justification: Equation (1)'s mathematical loss definition changes from an L1 norm to a squared norm, which is not equivalent notation. The problem formulation and appendix prototype equations remain unchanged, with no added theorem, proof, or derivation.

C1.justification: Both retain the same contributions: multi-agent dataset construction, analysis of textual descriptions, and prototype-conditioned text-controlled diffusion. The abstract retains the claims concerning 11 of 12 datasets and 12.52% MSE/6.34% MAE controllability improvements; the conclusion's generalization claims also remain.

C2.justification: Appendix A.9 adds a substantive rationale for keeping textual descriptions independent of decomposed components: preserving fidelity to the original series representation. This replaces the earlier emphasis on periodicity rather than time. The reported failure of time-segmented descriptions and other result interpretations remain.

D1.justification: Appendix A.9 newly specifies how STL images and original-series text enter the existing exploratory setup. Section 4.1 removes the rule-based-extraction qualifier while retaining the standalone LLM description. Hardware, training hyperparameters, and appendix algorithms are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds Time-MMD and its annotation limitations and broadens conditional-diffusion coverage, including CSDI, Time Weaver, and structured state-space approaches. The introduction also adds TimeRAF. These additions extend the research context while retaining the central positioning against GenG and TimeDP.

P1.justification: v3 rewrites related-work passages, edits the training and STL explanations, fixes the unresolved Figure ?? reference, and updates author text. Existing agent-strategy material receives its own Section 5.5. These are localized revisions within the retained document structure.

P2.justification: v1 Table 5 is divided into a text-type table and a separate agent-strategy Table 6, with revised captions and placement. Subsequent tables are renumbered. Figures and other table structures are retained, apart from ordinary page reflow.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves clarity and research context through the separate strategy section/table, repaired figure reference, expanded related work, and more explicit STL input description. Empirical coverage and support remain unchanged. The unexplained loss revision provides no demonstrated performance benefit, so the supported quality gains are limited to exposition, organization, and documentation.
